title: Business calendars
purpose: Find the opening hours and holidays that service targets count their times in, and open a calendar to see or change them.
summary: The opening hours and holidays that service targets count in. A target without a calendar runs around the clock. Only the admin role can open this page.

tasks.title: Find a calendar
steps: Type part of the name in [[Search]] and select [[Apply]].
Select the calendar's name to open it.

tasks.title: Add a calendar
steps: Select [[New business calendar]], name it and enter the opening hours for each day.
Save, then add the holidays on the calendar's page.

tasks.title: See which targets use a calendar
steps: Read the [[Active targets]] column, or open the calendar to list them.

good_to_know: Without a calendar a target runs around the clock, so nights and holidays count.
A calendar that active targets use cannot be made inactive until those targets are changed.
Hours and holidays are in the laboratory's time zone.
Changes to a calendar apply to tickets created or recalculated afterwards.

items.label: Search
items.description: Matches the calendar name, ignoring case.

items.label: Status
items.description: All statuses and All show active and inactive calendars. Active or Inactive filters on the Active setting.

items.label: New business calendar
items.description: Opens the form to add a calendar.

items.label: Service targets
items.description: Opens the list of service targets.

items.label: Calendar
items.description: The calendar's name, which opens its page. Always shown; default sort is name.

items.label: Opening hours
items.description: The days that have hours, abbreviated, with their intervals, for example Mon 07:00-19:00. Closed days are left out.

items.label: Holidays
items.description: How many holidays the calendar has.

items.label: Active targets
items.description: How many active service targets count their times in this calendar.

items.label: Filter and sort (phones)
items.description: On a phone the search, status filter, Apply, Clear all and Columns are behind one Filter and sort button.

items.label: Apply / Clear all
items.description: Apply combines the search and the status filter and returns to page 1. Clear all restores the unfiltered list.

items.label: Column headings
items.description: The Calendar and Status headings sort all matching calendars.

items.label: Columns
items.description: Show, hide or reorder columns for your account. The Calendar column stays visible.

items.label: Empty states
items.description: No business calendars yet explains that targets then run around the clock. No calendars match these filters offers to clear the filters.
